# CO2.trade

Independent reference project on carbon markets, carbon accounting and CO₂-related market structures.

## Canonical Resource

[Home](https://co2.trade/)


## Purpose

CO2.trade provides an independent reference on carbon markets, emissions accounting, trading mechanisms and related reference structures.

## Administrative

No separate administrative resources are published.
